_readme: Status chips on index.html come from here. Statuses: Live (public and usable for its real job), Beta (public but marked beta, demo or pre-release), Lab (experiment, not shipped), Archived (stopped). Change a status only with the evidence line updated, then run python3 tools/build_products.py.
